questions.question_en: How many whole numbers are there between 11² and 12²?
questions.question_hi: 11² और 12² के बीच कितनी पूर्ण संख्या हैं?
questions.solution:
11² = 121 and 12² = 144.
Whole numbers strictly between them = 144 - 121 - 1 = 22.
Formula: Between n² and (n + 1)², there are 2n non-perfect square numbers.
Here 2 × 11 = 22.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is correct in respect of the number 1729?
questions.question_hi: संख्या 1729 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?

options.text: It cannot be written as the sum of the cubes of two positive integers.
It can be written as the sum of the cubes of two positive integers in only one way.
It can be written as the sum of the cubes of two positive integers in only two ways.
It can be written as the sum of the cubes of two positive integers in three ways.

questions.solution:
1729 is the Hardy-Ramanujan number, the smallest number expressible as the sum of two cubes in two different ways:
1729 = 1³ + 12³ = 1 + 1728 = 1729
1729 = 9³ + 10³ = 729 + 1000 = 1729.

questions.question_en: The number 2918245 is divisible by which of the following numbers?
questions.question_hi: संख्या 2918245 निम्नलिखित में से किस संख्या से विभाज्य है?
questions.solution:
Divisibility by 11: Sum of digits at odd places - Sum of digits at even places.
Odd places (from right): 5 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 10.
Even places (from right): 4 + 8 + 9 = 21.
Difference = 21 - 10 = 11, which is divisible by 11.
Hence, 2918245 is divisible by 11.

questions.question_en: What is the unit digit in the expansion of 67³²?
questions.question_hi: 67³² के विस्तार में इकाई का अंक क्या है?
questions.solution:
Last digit of base = 7. Power = 32.
Cyclicity of 7 is 4: 7¹=7, 7²=9, 7³=3, 7⁴=1.
32 is divisible by 4 with remainder 0.
Therefore, unit digit = 7⁴ = 1.

questions.question_en: What is the remainder when 2¹⁰¹ is divided by 101?
questions.question_hi: 2¹⁰¹ को 101 से भाग देने पर शेषफल क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
101 is a prime number.
By Fermat's Little Theorem: a^(p - 1) ≡ 1 (mod p) for gcd(a, p) = 1.
2¹⁰⁰ ≡ 1 (mod 101).
Therefore, 2¹⁰¹ = 2¹⁰⁰ × 2¹ ≡ 1 × 2 ≡ 2 (mod 101).
Remainder = 2.

questions.question_en: Let ab (a ≠ b) be a two-digit prime number such that ba is also a prime number. Find the sum of all such numbers.
questions.question_hi: मान लीजिए ab (a ≠ b) दो अंकों की एक अभाज्य संख्या है, इस प्रकार है कि ba भी एक अभाज्य संख्या है। ऐसी सभी संख्याओं का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Two-digit primes whose reversals are also distinct primes:
Pairs: (13, 31), (17, 71), (37, 73), (79, 97).
Sum = 13 + 31 + 17 + 71 + 37 + 73 + 79 + 97 = 418.

questions.question_en: How many integers in the set {1, 2, 3, ..., 100} have exactly 3 divisors?
questions.question_hi: समूह {1, 2, 3..., 100} में ऐसे कितने पूर्णांक हैं जिनके ठीक 3 भाजक हैं?
questions.solution:
A number has exactly 3 divisors if and only if it is the square of a prime number (p² has divisors 1, p, p²).
Primes whose squares are ≤ 100:
2² = 4
3² = 9
5² = 25
7² = 49
(Next prime is 11, and 11² = 121 > 100).
There are exactly 4 such numbers: 4, 9, 25, 49.

questions.question_en: If N = 3¹⁴ + 3¹³ – 12, then what is the largest prime factor of N?
questions.question_hi: यदि N = 3¹⁴ + 3¹³ – 12 , तो N का अधिकतम अभाज्य गुणनखण्ड ज्ञात करें?
questions.solution:
N = 3¹³(3 + 1) - 12 = 4 × 3¹³ - 12 = 12(3¹² - 1).
3¹² - 1 = (3⁶ + 1)(3⁶ - 1) = (729 + 1)(729 - 1) = 730 × 728.
730 = 73 × 10.
73 is a prime number. Checking other factors of 728: 728 = 2³ × 7 × 13.
Hence, the largest prime factor is 73.

questions.question_en: Find the value of the given expression: 30 – [40 – {56 – (25 – 13 – 12)}]
questions.solution:
Innermost bracket: 25 - 13 - 12 = 0.
Next: 56 - 0 = 56.
Next: 40 - 56 = -16.
Expression: 30 - (-16) = 30 + 16 = 46.

Formula: (a³ + b³) / (a² - ab + b²) = a + b.
Here a = 0.7, b = 0.3.
Value = 0.7 + 0.3 = 1.
Formula: [(a + b)² + (a - b)²] / (a² + b²) = 2(a² + b²) / (a² + b²) = 2.

questions.question_en: Find the value of (√5 + √3)(√5 – √3).
If x = √64 + √121 – √169, then find the value of x².
Find the value of the given expression: √(20 - √(20 - √(20 - ... ∞)))
questions.solution:
Let y = √(20 - y) ⇒ y² + y - 20 = 0 ⇒ (y + 5)(y - 4) = 0.
Since y > 0, y = 4.
Short Trick: Factor 20 into two consecutive numbers: 20 = 5 × 4. Since there is a minus (-) sign, the smaller factor is the answer: 4.

questions.question_en: The ratio of three numbers is 5:7:9 and their least common multiple is 1260. What is the difference between the largest and smallest numbers?
questions.question_hi: तीन संख्याओ का अनुपात 5:7:9 है और उनका लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य 1260 है। सबसे बड़ी और सबसे छोटी संख्या के बीच का अंतर कितना है?
questions.solution:
Let the numbers be 5H, 7H, 9H, where H is their HCF.
LCM = 5 × 7 × 9 × H = 315H.
315H = 1260 ⇒ H = 4.
Difference between largest and smallest = 9H - 5H = 4H = 4 × 4 = 16.

questions.question_en: The greatest common factor (HCF) of two numbers is 11 and their least common multiple (LCM) is 693. If one of them is 77, find the other number.
questions.question_hi: दो संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक 11 और उनका लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य 693 है। यदि उनमें से एक संख्या 77 है, तो दूसरी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM
77 × Number2 = 11 × 693
⇒ Number2 = (11 × 693) / 77 = 693 / 7 = 99.

questions.question_en: Simplify (5z – 12y)² + (12z + 5y)² – 144z².
questions.question_hi: (5z – 12y)² + (12z + 5y)² – 144z² को सरल कीजिए।
questions.solution:
(5z - 12y)² = 25z² + 144y² - 120zy.
(12z + 5y)² = 144z² + 25y² + 120zy.
Sum = 25z² + 144z² + 144y² + 25y² = 169z² + 169y².
Subtracting 144z² = (169z² - 144z²) + 169y² = 25z² + 169y².

questions.question_en: The standard deviation of a set of n values x1, x2, ..., xn is 5. What is the standard deviation of the set x1 – 7, x2 – 7, ... , xn – 7?
questions.question_hi: n मानों का एक समूह x1, x2, ..., xn का मानक विचलन 5 है। n मानों x1 – 7, x2 – 7, ... , xn–7 का मानक विचलन होगा:
questions.solution:
Standard deviation is independent of the change of origin. Adding or subtracting a constant to every observation does not change the standard deviation.
Therefore, the new standard deviation remains 5.
questions.trick: SD is invariant under addition or subtraction of a constant ⇒ 5.

questions.question_en: The mean of a sample data is 60 and the median is 48. Find the mode of this distribution.
questions.question_hi: एक नमूना आंकड़ों का माध्य 60 और मध्यिका 48 है। इस बंटन का बहुलक ज्ञात कीजिये?
questions.solution:
By Karl Pearson's empirical relation:
Mode = 3 × Median - 2 × Mean
= 3 × 48 - 2 × 60 = 144 - 120 = 24.

questions.question_en: Let A and B be two players who are playing the game to hit the target. The probabilities of hitting the target by A and B is 2/3 and 3/4, respectively. What is the probability that exactly one of them hits the target?
questions.question_hi: मान लीजिए A और B दो खिलाड़ी हैं जो टारगेट को हिट करने के लिए खेल रहे हैं। A और B द्वारा टारगेट को हिट किये जाने की प्रायिकताएं क्रमशः 2/3 और 3/4 हैं। उनमें से किसी भी एक द्वारा टारगेट को सटीकता से हिट किये जाने की क्या प्रायिकता है?

questions.question_en: A speaks the truth 5 times out of 7 and B speaks the truth 8 times out of 9. What is the probability that they will contradict each other in stating the same fact?
questions.question_hi: A, 7 में से 5 बार सच बोलता है और B, 9 में से 8 बार सच बोलता है। इसकी क्या प्रायिकता होगी की वे एक ही तथ्य को कहने में एक दूसरे का खंडन करेंगे?
questions.solution:
P(A speaks truth) = 5/7, P(A lies) = 2/7.
P(B speaks truth) = 8/9, P(B lies) = 1/9.
They contradict each other when one tells truth and the other lies:
P(Contradict) = P(A)P(B') + P(A')P(B)
= (5/7 × 1/9) + (2/7 × 8/9) = (5 + 16) / 63 = 21 / 63 = 1/3.
